findings.current: without the slightest desire for the immense power of the World Hunter Federation
findings.defect: This reads as though the crowd had no desire to possess the Federation’s power. The Korean says their gratitude and respect were free of any personal or ulterior motive toward the Federation, not that they lacked a desire to acquire power.
findings.rationale: 일말의 사심도 없이 describes the absence of personal or ulterior motives; it does not specifically describe a lack of desire to possess power.
findings.replacement: without the slightest personal agenda toward the immense power that was the World Hunter Federation

summary: One minor shift in the crowd’s motive: the English suggests they did not want power, rather than that their gratitude carried no ulterior motive toward the Federation.
